title: Ramakrishna v. M/s ABC Industries
text: The workman, Ramakrishna, challenges his retrenchment by M/s ABC Industries as illegal and void under the Industrial Disputes Act. The workman had continuous service of 8 years when he was retrenched without payment of retrenchment compensation and without following the last-come-first-go principle mandated under Section 25G of the Industrial Disputes Act. The employer claimed the retrenchment was due to surplus labour. The Labour Court found that the employer did not comply with Section 25F of the Industrial Disputes Act and ordered reinstatement with back wages. This High Court upholds the Labour Court award. The retrenchment is declared void ab initio. The workman is entitled to reinstatement with full back wages and continuity of service under the Industrial Disputes Act. The employer is directed to reinstate the workman within 30 days. 50% back wages shall be paid within 60 days.
